nodes.description: Public payable entry point that parses caller calldata, applies param mapping and executes the stkAave claim through the proxy.
Public payable direct-execution entry point for a single action; decodes inputs, claims rewards and logs via DefisaverLogger.
Internal action logic that calls AaveIncentivesController.claimRewards and returns the claimed amount plus log data.
Decodes caller-controlled _callData into the Params struct (assets, amount, to).
Injects subscription/return values into uint parameters based on the paramMapping code.
Injects subscription/return values into address parameters and resolves the DSProxy address/owner for mapping codes 254/255.
Registry function gated by a block.timestamp comparison against changeStartTime plus waitPeriod.
Registry function that writes block.timestamp into entry.changeStartTime to start a contract change.
Constant state variable holding the Aave incentives controller address used for claiming rewards.
Constant DefisaverLogger instance used to emit action events.
Constant DFSRegistry instance used for contract address lookups.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization and event attribution.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used for registry change wait-period gates.
External call to AaveIncentivesController.claimRewards(assets, amount, to) that claims rewards to a caller-specified recipient.
External call to logger.logActionDirectEvent emitting arbitrary caller-supplied log data.
ABI-encoded Params blob supplied by the caller to executeAction.
Array of subscribed values used to replace mapped inputs.
Array of mapping codes deciding which inputs get substituted.
Values returned by previously executed actions that can be injected as inputs.
Decoded Params struct holding assets, amount and recipient inside executeAction.
Amount of stkAave rewards claimed, returned as bytes32.
ABI-encoded params and claimed amount emitted in the ActionEvent.
ABI-encoded Params blob supplied to executeActionDirect.
Decoded Params struct inside executeActionDirect.
Log payload forwarded to the DefisaverLogger.
Params (assets, amount, to) passed into the internal claim logic.
Reward amount returned by the incentives controller.
Encoded params plus claimed amount returned to the caller.
Raw calldata decoded into the Params struct.
Params struct produced by decoding the caller-supplied calldata.
